name: Breakout Card
tagline: favstash's breakout-card: a paper page with a static grid, the speaker in a card the head breaks out of, dark pills, blur-to-focus.

motion.direction: favstash `breakout-card`. Page `#fcfcfd` with a static 54 px grid; the speaker lives in a card (`card` mode, radius 18) the head appears to break out of; dark material `goldd` pills 96 px tall and cards radius 34–36 at y 200–1000; Montserrat: pills 38 bold, card text 32–37, headline 112 extra-bold, captions 60 bold lowercase. Everything "blurs into focus": opacity 0, scale 0.7–0.86, blur 16 → 0 in ~0.35 s; out 0.25 s; alternate page / camera every 4–10 s on hard cuts; push 1.2 → 1.27. Green / red only for a real check or strike (`stamp`). Navy `ter` accent.
